mapper.insert: INSERT INTO complaint_track (id, complaint_id, operator, content, is_deleted, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{complaintId}, #{operator}, #{content}, #{isDeleted}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, complaint_id, operator, content, is_deleted, create_time, update_time FROM complaint_track WHERE complaint_id = #{complaintId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time ASC, id ASC
